source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-35

procedures.title: Power steering pump: remove and install
steps: Unbolt the pump from its mounting parts and lift it out.
Remove the drive pulley nut.
Pull the pulley with J-21239 (stamped pulleys) or J-8433-1 with adapter J-8433-2 (cast iron pulleys); never hammer it off or the pump will be damaged.
Installation: fit the pulley, drawing it on with the pulley nut; do not hammer on the pump shaft.
Set the pump in place on the car and fit its mounting parts loosely (see figure 62 in the manual).
Connect and tighten the hose fittings.
Fill the reservoir and bleed the pump by turning the pulley backward (counterclockwise seen from the front) until no more air bubbles appear.
Fit the belt over the pulley.
Tension the belt as under Pump Belt Tension.
Bleed the system as under Maintenance and Adjustments.

procedures.title: Power steering control valve ball stud seal: replace
steps: Remove the pitman arm as under Steering Linkage.
Remove the clamp by taking off its nut, bolt and spacer; if it is a crimped clamp, straighten the end and pull the clamp and seal off the stud.
Fit the new seal and clamp over the stud so the seal lips mate with the clamp.
Center the ball stud, seal and clamp in the adapter housing opening, then fit the spacer, bolt and nut (see figure 64 in the manual).
notes: Service replacements use a nut-and-bolt clamp in place of the crimped type.

procedures.title: Power steering control valve: remove and install
steps: Removal: raise the front of the car and support it on stands.
Remove the relay rod-to-control valve clamp bolt.
Disconnect the 2 pump-to-valve hoses, draining fluid into a container, then disconnect the 2 valve-to-power cylinder hoses.
Remove the ball stud nut at the pitman arm and free the valve from the pitman arm.
Swing the pitman arm right, clear of the valve, and unscrew the valve from the relay rod.
Take the valve out of the car.
Installation: install in reverse order.
Reconnect the lines, fill with fluid, bleed out the air as under Maintenance and Adjustments, and grease the ball joint.

procedures.title: Power steering control valve: balance
steps: Balance the valve after any disassembly, or to cure steering that is harder one way than the other (see figure 66 in the manual).
With the valve installed, hoses connected and reservoir filled, leave the piston rod disconnected from the frame bracket (detach it if the car is in service).
With the car on a hoist, start the engine.
